# DUCT TAPE

> DUCT TAPE is a drag collective from Berlin known for producing Berlin's biggest drag show (die größte Drag Show Berlins), founded in 2022 by EMI, Symba and Magda von Pfeffer. It combines drag with theatre, comedy, dance, music and performance art and produces shows, parties and regular formats in Berlin and on tour. Website in German (main) and English.

Key facts:
- Productions include the self-written Christmas musical HOLY GLORY and the YouTube series HOT STUFF with eBay.
- Regular formats: Drag Bingo Nights (Torte Bar, Neukölln, and Bademeister Bar, Weißensee) and the Fritz-Kola Drag Brunch at The Dawn Neukölln (KALLE rooftop, Karl-Marx-Straße 101, 12043 Berlin).
- Own party series: Cosmopolitan.
- 2024: REMIX Popculture Icon Award for cultural engagement.
- 2025: on the main stage of Berlin CSD (Pride) with 25 artists in front of around 30,000 people.
- 2026: India tour with Gaysi Family and the Goethe-Institut (Mumbai, New Delhi, Kolkata).
- Clients and partners include YouTube, Lieferando, Lollapalooza, Berliner CSD, eBay, fritz-kola, Tinder, e.l.f., Aperol and Jung von Matt.
- Booking: booking@ducttape.berlin. Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/ducttapeberlin/
- Tickets and all dates: https://rausgegangen.de/organizations/duct-tape/
